snippet.title: Death Rabbit // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567780/Death_Rabbit/

The city that never sleeps has taken a sinister turn, and the dark tunnels of the MTA have become the epicenter of a horrifying outbreak. As Alisa, you must navigate through a labyrinthine underground world fraught with danger, where unspeakable horrors lurk around every corner.

Developed by
Rabbit Studios
